label: AaaS observed agents
info: Two parallel agents, join, then repeat the writer; lifecycle observations are configured in settings.js

name: Accept and dispatch
Require acknowledged result
Invoke writer again after join
Finalize only acknowledged success
Finalize failure
func:
if (typeof msg.runId !== 'string' || !msg.runId) { node.warn('Uncorrelated workflow failure'); return null; }
msg.payload = { runId: msg.runId, eventId: `${msg.runId}:failed`, status: 'failed' }; return msg;

name: Private finalizer headers
func: msg.method = 'POST'; msg.url = 'http://api:3095/finalize'; msg.headers = { authorization: `Bearer ${env.get('INTERNAL_TOKEN')}`, 'content-type': 'application/json' }; return msg;
